sources.title: Ukraine opens access to battlefield data for AI model training
sources.snippet: Ukraine is granting access to battlefield data for the training of AI models, Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov announced today. A recently adopted government resolution allows partners to train artificial intelligence models for unmanned systems using authentic data gathered from active combat operations.
